reuse.why: The change reuses recurrence conversion and weekend adjustment helpers, but getDatesInRange implements daily occurrence filtering separately from the shared helpers.

duplication.why: The range handler duplicates daily exclusion logic and the conditional weekend adjustment dispatch already implemented elsewhere.

placement.why: Most scheduling policy remains in shared/schedules.ts, but the range handler also owns exclusion policy and adjustment-specific search margins.

scope.why: All edits support the requested scheduling rules, range endpoint, configuration propagation, or associated tests.

maintainability.why: The holiday predicate provides a useful shared definition, but separate occurrence-processing paths require maintainers to coordinate future policy changes across modules.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/schedules/app.ts:getDatesInRange filters daily occurrences with d.isWeekend directly instead of sharing the weekend-and-holiday exclusion definition used by getWeekdayOccurrences.

disguised_duplication.where: getDatesInRange reshapes existing occurrence filtering and conditional adjustment into an imperative loop, retaining parallel policy implementations rather than sharing them.

abstraction_drift.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend gains a holidays parameter, getNextDate gains a daily-skipping branch, and getDatesInRange independently implements daily exclusion instead of using the shared exclusion policy.
